Chapter 4 — Spatial Interpolation of Solar Radiation over West Africa

119 stations · full 1983–2023 record · 6 interpolation methods · everything computed live in your browser

Data source

This tool ships with your CMSAF SIS/SISC data (119 stations, Jan 1983–Dec 2023). To use different data instead, upload a CSV with columns: station, lat, lon, year, month, value1[, value2...]

Monthly Grid Map

All 6 interpolation methods for the selected month, side by side — 3 columns × 2 rows, labeled (a)–(f), same color scale throughout, clipped to the West Africa boundary. Click "Download this grid as one image" to save it as a single PNG for your thesis. Change the month above and click Compute to get a different month's comparison.

Cross-Validation Accuracy (SIS, from your ArcGIS Geostatistical Analyst run) real ArcGIS output

Averaged across all 12 months. MedAE is the median absolute error — more robust than RMSE since GPI/LPI occasionally produce extreme extrapolation errors at edge stations. This table covers SIS only (your ArcGIS export didn't include a SISC cross-validation run).
